title: Source-contract tests are line-ending portable

permissions.reason: Line-ending portability for static source-contract tests does not change runtime authorization.

frontend.reason: No user-facing route, menu or form is added; only test/tooling reads of existing source files are normalized.

permissions.reason: Permission codes and enforcement are unchanged.

ui_permissions.reason: UI permission guards are unchanged; only how tests read their source is portable.

frontend_tests.reason: frontend.required=false pairs frontend_tests=na; Vitest source-contract coverage stays in affected_paths, not a product UI surface.

runtime_verification.reason: Acceptance is the Vitest source-contract suite.

deployment.reason: No application deployment change; Git attributes only affect checkout line endings.

notes: Source-contract toContain checks compare LF tokens. Windows CRLF checkouts made those tests fail without changing product source. Tests now normalize CRLF to LF before assertion, and frontend/.gitattributes pins eol=lf for future checkouts.
